gumroad._comment: Paste the full https URL of the Gumroad product page here (owner step 3). While it is empty the Pro button stays disabled and says so - it never pretends a shop exists. Nothing from Gumroad is loaded into this site; the button is a link.

analytics._comment: provider: "none" or "plausible". PostHog moved to its own block below because it is configured cookieless.

posthog._comment: Optional page-view measurement, cookieless. Empty by default: with no projectKey no snippet is emitted and nothing third-party loads. Filling it also needs 'Cookieless server hash mode' enabled in the PostHog project settings - see README.

pro._comment: Run `node scripts/make-license.js init` on your own machine to generate the signing keypair. It writes the private half to .license-key.json (gitignored, back it up) and fills publicKey here. Until publicKey is set, Pro stays disabled and the site shows it as unavailable.
